summary: Nassau County BOCES argues that E‑Rate should retain its core supports, extend permanent eligibility to cybersecurity equipment, and preserve consortium‑based lead applicant status to maintain administrative efficiencies for small districts. Nassau BOCES argues for maintaining and expanding E‑Rate support for cybersecurity, opposes new funding conditions on screen‑time limits, criticizes proposed consortium filing timing, requests data‑based review of discount matrix changes, and urges preservation of core E‑Rate benefits.
